title: vCon - Unsigned Form
description: JSON schema for the unsigned form of vCon (Conversational Data Container) as defined in RFCXXXX

vcon.description: DEPRECATED: Syntactic version of the JSON format. This was used to indicate schema changes in the Internet-Draft versions

uuid.description: Globally unique identifier for the vCon. SHOULD be a version 8 UUID

extensions.description: List of names of all vCon extensions used by this vCon

critical.description: List of extension names that a consumer MUST support to safely process this vCon

created_at.description: Creation time of this vCon in RFC3339 format

updated_at.description: Last modified time of this vCon in RFC3339 format

subject.description: Subject or topic of the conversation

redacted.description: Reference to the unredacted or less redacted vCon prior instance

uuid.description: UUID of the unredacted or less redacted vCon prior instance

url.description: HTTPS URL where the referenced vCon is stored

content_hash.description: Hash(es) of the external content using format: algorithm-base64url_encoded_hash

amended.description: Reference to the prior vCon instance version that this vCon amends

uuid.description: UUID of the prior vCon instance version

url.description: HTTPS URL where the referenced vCon is stored

content_hash.description: Hash(es) of the external content (required if url is provided)

then.$comment: uuid is optional only if an external reference is provided

sessions.description: Array of Session Objects, each grouping the Dialog and Event Objects of one session of the conversation

parties.description: Array of Party Objects representing all parties involved in the conversation

events.description: Array of Event Objects; order is not significant, Event Objects are sequenced by their time parameter

dialog.description: Array of Dialog Objects containing the captured conversation content

analysis.description: Array of Analysis Objects containing analysis performed on the conversational data

attachments.description: Array of Attachment Objects for ancillary documents related to the conversation

Session.description: Represents one session of the conversation and references the Dialog Objects which are part of it; a Session Object with no parameters is permitted

start.description: Start time of the session in RFC3339 format; SHOULD be present

duration.description: Duration of the session in seconds

parties.description: Indices of all parties that were part of the session; SHOULD be present; the first party is the implied originator

originator.description: Index of the originating party; only provided if the first party in parties is not the originator

dialog.description: Indices of the Dialog Objects which are part of the session

SessionReference.description: Session_Reference Object: the relationship of another Session Object to the Session Object which contains this reference

session.description: Index of the referenced Session Object in the sessions array

type.description: Type of relationship: child, peer, precursor, breakout, or a value defined in a vCon extension

description.description: Free form text description of the relationship

Party.description: Represents a party involved in the conversation

stir.description: STIR PASSporT in JWS Compact Serialization form

mailto.description: Email address for the party in any common form, including a bare address or a MAILTO URL

did.description: Decentralized Identifier (DID) URI for the party

validation.description: Label or token identifying the method of identity validation used

gmlpos.description: Geographic location in GML pos format (latitude longitude)

uuid.description: Free form unique identifier for the participant; not constrained to UUID syntax

org.description: Organization to which the party belongs

dept.description: Department to which the party belongs

Civicaddress.description: Civic address information for a party's location

Event.description: Represents an event which occurred in a session, such as a party joining, a key press or a transfer

type.description: Type of event: join, drop, hold, unhold, mute, unmute, keydown, keyup, consultation-start, blind-transfer, consultative-transfer, transfer-abandoned, or a value defined in a vCon extension

time.description: Time of the event in RFC3339 format

session.description: Index of the Session Object in which the event occurred; for transfer event types, the Session Object for the original call

party.description: Index of the party to which the event applies; for transfer event types, the Transferor

dialog.description: Index of the Dialog Object associated with the event; MUST NOT be present for transfer event types

button.description: DTMF digit, character or string (required for keydown and keyup events)

transferee.description: Party index of the Transferee (transfer event types)

transfer_target.description: Party index of the Transfer Target (transfer event types; optional for transfer-abandoned)

consultation.description: Session index of the consultative call (consultation-start and consultative-transfer; optional for transfer-abandoned)

target_session.description: Session index of the target call (blind-transfer and consultative-transfer)

Event.$comment: The rules for each known type follow the Event Object Parameter Applicability by Type tables. An Event Object with a type which is not listed is only checked for the parameters common to all types.

Dialog.description: Represents a segment of captured conversation

type.description: Type of dialog: recording, text, incomplete, or a value defined in a vCon extension

start.description: Start time of the dialog in RFC3339 format; SHOULD be present unless not known

parties.description: Index/indices of the parties that contributed to the dialog content; SHOULD be present for recording and text types

mediatype.description: Media type of the dialog content; MUST be present for inline content; not required when Dialog Content is absent

filename.description: Original filename of the dialog content

body.description: Inline content of the dialog (for inline files).  Any type for encoding json; a string for encoding base64url or none.

encoding.description: Encoding type for inline content: base64url, json, none, or a value defined in a vCon extension

url.description: HTTPS URL for externally referenced content

disposition.description: Reason the call or conversation failed (required for incomplete type, SHOULD NOT be present for other types): no-answer, congestion, failed, busy, hung-up, voicemail-no-message, or a value defined in a vCon extension; "failed" SHOULD be used when the reason is not known

session_id.description: Session ID(s) for the dialog, correlated with the parties parameter

application.description: Application, communication channel or context of the conversation

message_id.description: Unique message identifier from the messaging system

definitions.$comment: The rules for each known type follow the Dialog Object Parameter Applicability by Type table. A Dialog Object with a type which is not listed is only checked for the rules common to all types.

SessionId.description: Session identifier with local and remote UUIDs

Attachment.description: Represents an ancillary document related to the conversation

purpose.description: text description of what the attachment is for

start.description: Time the attachment was sent/exchanged in RFC3339 format

party.description: Index of the party that contributed the attachment

dialog.description: Index of the dialog this attachment is part of (optional; at least one of dialog or session MUST be present)

session.description: Index/indices of the Session Object(s) this attachment is related to

mediatype.description: Media type of the attachment content; MUST be present for inline content; not required when Attachment Content is absent

body.description: Inline content of the attachment (for inline files).  Any type for encoding json; a string for encoding base64url or none.

encoding.description: Encoding type for inline content: base64url, json, none, or a value defined in a vCon extension

Analysis.description: Represents analysis performed on the conversational data

type.description: Semantic type of analysis (e.g., report, sentiment, summary, transcript, translation, tts)

dialog.description: Index/indices of dialog objects this analysis is based on (optional)

session.description: Index/indices of Session Objects this analysis is based on (optional)

attachment.description: Index/indices of attachment objects this analysis is based on (optional)

analysis.description: Index/indices of other Analysis Objects this analysis is based on (optional); MUST NOT reference itself

mediatype.description: Media type of the analysis content; SHOULD be provided for inline content and for external content without an HTTPS Content-Type header; when no media type is defined for the data format, the vendor, product and schema parameters SHOULD identify the format instead

filename.description: Original filename of the analysis data

vendor.description: Vendor or product name that generated the analysis

product.description: Product name to differentiate from other vendor products

schema.description: Token or label for the data format/schema of the analysis

body.description: Inline content of the analysis (for inline files).  Any type for encoding json; a string for encoding base64url or none.

Analysis.$comment: At least one of the dialog, session, attachment or analysis parameters SHOULD be present. An Analysis Object MUST NOT reference itself in the analysis parameter; this is not enforced by this schema.

not.$comment: The redacted and amended parameters are mutually exclusive

then.$comment: At least one Session Object MUST exist if the events array or the dialog array contain Objects

$comment: This schema is permissive: parameters and type values which are not defined in RFCXXXX do not cause validation to fail. At least one of the parties, dialog, analysis or attachments parameters SHOULD be present. SHOULD-level statements are not enforced by this schema. Index values are not checked against the size of the array which they reference.
